normalization: Originals as fetched under original/, pinned to a commit of the repository named in origin.items. text/<slug>.txt is the TEI reduced to plain text by seat.py (rebuild/corpora/ea-corpora-27), notes and apparatus dropped, divisions kept. No text was corrected by hand.
scope: The five works entire in the Perseus TEI: the Agricola, Germania and Dialogus, the surviving books of the Histories (I–V.26) and of the Annals (I–VI, XI–XVI). Held above all for Histories 5.13, the undated account of the portents before the siege of Jerusalem, set against Josephus BJ 6.288–315 (seat josephus) and the Apocalypse in #1737.
verified_loci: Hist. 5.1, the year that opens Book 5: Titus chosen to finish Judaea — 'Eiusdem anni principio Caesar Titus, perdomandae Iudaeae delectus a patre'
Hist. 5.13, the prodigies: armies in the sky, the temple lit by fire from the clouds — 'visae per caelum concurrere acies, rutilantia arma et subito nubium igne conlucere templum'
Hist. 5.13, the doors of the shrine opened, and the voice: the gods are departing — 'apertae repente delubri fores et audita maior humana vox excedere deos; simul ingens motus excedentium'
Hist. 5.13, the oracle in the ancient writings of the priests — 'antiquis sacerdotum litteris contineri eo ipso tempore fore ut valesceret Oriens profectique Iudaea rerum potirentur'
Ann. 15.44, the Christians under Nero — 'Christianos appellabat'
why_seated: Tacitus gives the signs that preceded the fall of the Temple without a date, inside his narrative of the year 70: the undated witness of the three set side by side in The Portents Before the Fall (#1737). Seated whole, in Latin, so that the passage is read in its book.
